name: 西施
variant: 浓彩国风宫廷立绘风格稿
prompt:
Create ONE brand-new richly colored character portrait of Xi Shi (西施), an adult Chinese beauty around 23, for a premium Chinese historical character game. A COMPLETE STYLE RESET: abandon ink-wash, old-paper, sepia, desaturated colors, rough linen and rustic painting. The viewer must immediately distinguish luxurious formal court attire from an ordinary person's clothing.
Use case: stylized-concept, premium Chinese historical game character key art. Square composition; final project delivery 512 x 512.

VISUAL STYLE:
Highly polished vivid digital painting, sophisticated realistic facial anatomy and painterly rendering, premium illustrated RPG character portrait with cinematic lighting. NOT photographic and NOT anime. Rich jewel tones and controlled deep shadows. Delicate warm light on natural skin, luminous highlights along fabric folds and metal edges, dimensional tactile textiles. Precise ornamental detail supported by broad rich color shapes, no muddy brown cast. Clear chromatic separation of green silk, crimson inner layers, gold embroidery and white jade.
BACKGROUND:
A deep, smooth peacock-blue to dark teal atmospheric backdrop, subtly suggesting a distant palace interior through soft unfocused warm amber light. No detailed architecture or distracting props. Absolutely no parchment texture, no paper grain, no watercolor wash, no ink splashes, no beige background.
CHARACTER:
A graceful adult Chinese woman, soft oval face, expressive dark almond-shaped eyes, refined straight brows, natural delicate nose, softly closed lips with muted natural rose color. Reflective, self-possessed, quietly captivating expression rather than a smile for the camera. Healthy natural skin; avoid doll-like enlarged eyes or glossy artificial beauty filters. Slight three-quarter view, gaze near the viewer. Elegant dark hair in an elaborate but believable swept-up bun with individual strand detail.
COSTUME — THE MAIN DESIGN TEST:
An opulent, fully clothed, richly layered cross-collar court robe, reimagined for a Chinese ancient-history game, not a claim of literal archaeological reconstruction. The outer robe is luminous DEEP JADE / EMERALD GREEN woven silk with broad curved folds and readable natural silk sheen. Across shoulders and lapels, exquisite antique-gold thread brocade in organized scrolling geometric / stylized cloud patterns. Embroidery must visibly sit ON rich textile, with highlights on fine threads; avoid flat printed yellow patterns. A dark CRANBERRY / CARMINE RED silk inner layer and a fine ivory collar create bold elegant contrast. Gold-edged layered lapels, structured drape, broad formal sleeve shapes cropped at lower corners. A small fine jade fastening and a glimpse of an ornate woven waist sash near the bottom if composition permits. Luxurious through construction, layering, dense controlled craftsmanship and material contrast; not a plain green robe with a few ornaments.
HAIR JEWELRY:
A refined integrated gold-and-white-jade hair comb and two slim gilded hairpins, with small carved jade details and a few delicate short dangling gold/jade elements at sides of the bun. Subtle small jade drop earrings. Design jewels with polished highlights, translucent edges and fine metalwork so they clearly differ from rough wood. Regal refinement without a massive queen's crown or modern tiara. Keep jewelry clear of face and eyes.
COMPOSITION:
Single upper-body portrait, from crown of hair to near upper waist, face large enough to retain identity at 512px, about upper 40 percent of canvas, clothing occupies much of lower half so luxurious textiles are clearly visible. Entire hair ornament inside frame with margin. Three-quarter torso, poised dignified shoulders. Fully covered shoulders and chest, no cleavage, no bare shoulders. Soft warm facial key light from upper left and a subtle cooler rim light; crisp focal detail on face, collar, embroidered shoulder and hair ornaments, secondary details softer.
COLOR TARGET:
Emerald jade silk + rich crimson silk + warm lustrous gold + small pale white-jade accents, against dark peacock-blue. Rich saturation, deep clean shadows, radiant but restrained highlights. This should feel like expensive formal portrait key art, NEVER humble, faded, dusty or rustic.

STRICT AVOID:
No text, title, calligraphy, seals, signatures, watermarks, borders, UI, contact sheet or multiple people. No paper texture, ink-wash aesthetic, sepia, low-saturation brown/beige palette, distressed cloth or rough homespun. No pale misty watercolor background. No armor, weapons, fantasy powers, halos, long elf ears, European gown, modern fashion, exaggerated cleavage, modern lipstick, Qing headdress, anime, chibi, plastic 3D, photo collage or giant flower props.
One cohesive new full-color painted portrait.
